events.title: The Future of Technology and Human Rights

events.title: Research and Technology Subcommittee Hearing - Innovation at Work: How Artificial Intelligence Is Improving American Lives and Advancing Discovery

events.title: Policies to Put Workers First in the AI Era with U.S. Senator Mark Kelly (D-Ariz)

events.description: Senator Mark Kelly on policies to protect and empower workers as AI reshapes the economy.
events.why: A sitting senator on AI labor policy, a short walk from SAIS.

events.title: A World Without Secrets: International Politics in an Era of Eroding Secrecy | Erik Lin-Greenberg
events.location: William J. Perry Conference Room, Encina Hall, Stanford, CA

events.why: Tech-and-security seminar on OSINT and secrecy for Bay Area tech-policy followers.

events.title: Joint Hearing: "Defend, Detect, Disclose: Responding to AI-Enabled Cyber Incidents"
